svg.title: It is complex linear and near zero invertible by geometric series, fixing the unit and the stated structures. The determining tests choose bk →0 and frame Uk,dMbk. At degree four all lower fields are fixed exactly: for simple gauge algebra the free spaces below four consist of unit multiples, whose degree inclusions remain the unit, annihilated by b. A test i has finite arity ni, labels vij ∈E0 d and smooth compact complex profile ψi supported on distinct configurations. Let Λ be a finite real linear combination of real readings.
